text: Prof. Ockrassa is a great guy. I'm just not that artsy fartsy :)

Professor Agresta taught our ITAL101 class this semester and she was awesome! The class was super easy. No quizzes/tests, just a weekly homework and lecture assignment. She gives good feedback and lets you turn in things late with no penalty. Great professor!

Dr. Long is an amazing professor. She was always so kind and bubbly. Professor Long always had a great attitude and seems to really enjoy her job teaching. Only thing is that her ENGW104 class is super difficult. I really had to work for everything. However, I have learned to become a much better writer and researcher, and I thank her for that.

Stunning professor. Exciting lectures, passion for the material, extremely forgiving of life situations outside of class. He tries to make a dense subject fun and easy to remember, not just for rote memorization reasons, but for clear understanding of the material and future application. Loves "gotcha" questions, but they help you learn.

Mrs. Ritch is great! As a professor she went a bit too fast for my liking, but maybe that was just me. You have the ability to get a lot of extra credit in this class, up to a whole letter grade on exams. You will have daily homework and frequent quizzes (some are take-home) so be prepared for that. I looked forward to going to this class!
Shes nice but her assignments aren't clear and are a lot of work. She also doesn't grade assignments until like 1-2 months later.

wish she was less lecture heavy bc i think i would have learned more public speaking skills if we were given more activities that have me practice my speaking rather than exams from a textbook. she has a clear grading criteria but still felt difficult to please, and as someone who used to struggle with a stutter, it was stressful. overall ok

This guys an all around good teacher. Do his work and you'll get an A. Kind of a conspiracy theorist but he doesn't push his own beliefs which is cool. I would take him again. Hes also fun and energetic.
the fairest accounting professor. She is a great teacher and communicator and tells you exactly what you need to succeed. makes the tests super straight forward and clear.
She is just awesome

This is for on liberation core. He is really passionate about the readings he assigned to us. The class is really clear. He can explain the difficult readings in a clear way. I really learn a lot from his class. 3 quizzes , 1 presentation and an accumulative finals. Take him!

Dr. Hussain lectures very heavy because he derives every equation for you. He covers most of the details that the book itself covers. The way he lectures is absolutely NOT confusing, he makes hard concepts seem easy. You will have TO WORK HARD. If you hope you can get a decent grade with minimum effort, avoid him! Extra credit 30 points on tests!

This class was very easy. If you read the textbook, you could easily get an A on the quizzes. The assignments and discussions were a little time consuming, but overall easy to understand and get a good grade on. The teacher responds promptly to emails and sets the class up for success. I would recommend!
Very sweet professor hate to see the reviews. Yes he might come off as rude but I believe it'd just his accent. Loved the extra credit always helped my grade.

Kristian is a great guy and I really appreciate the effort he took to instruct our class. Kristian is very creative and knows the programs well, but cannot teach very well. Syllabus and "what Kristian says" don't line up in terms of assignments and deadlines. Nice guy but not a very good communicator.
This is a very intensive class with many assignments, but Prof. Mordan was pretty supportive and cared about making sure that all students did well.

Average amounts of homework. Lectures were easy to follow. Weekly discussions and assignments that require you to collaborate with other people in your class. Study guides for extra credit, 1 for each exam. In conclusion: It was alright, there are more collaborative assignments than usual in math classes. Do the work and you'll be good.

Literally the goat of all teachers.
All the bad reviews are from students who didn't do the homework and expected to understand the material. He should be your number one option because he keeps the class interesting and you leave every class understanding the material. Also has office hours everyday and will help you with ANYTHING!
Very very fair grader. Goes off topic a lot, if you love real estate, his experience is unmatched and you would learn so much
Imagine learning integral math and another language simultaneously. Excellent class and teacher.

The drawback is having NO personal connection via phone, Zoom, etc. I think she actually reads submissions. She offers salient feedback. I worked hard in this internship & suspect others didn't. It's all about the checkboxes. It doesn't matter if you excel. There's no curve. It only matters if you meet the objective. I suspect we all earned "A"s.

An amazing teacher who cares about his students but is also firm on what he expects. Dont even think about asking for extensions on homework or being quiet in class and expecting an A. You can expect a lot of homework but take it from me whos had him in person and online, you'll learn a lot of valuable things aside from the accounting work, worth
One of my favorite professors! He is a retired plaice officer, he definitely knows his stuff. If you have an option to take this class do it! Funny Guy!

The material is pretty easy, plus Janette is very clear in her lectures and explains concepts well. I took the class online, I watched the lectures at double speed and followed along with her examples in excel. I never even looked at the textbook and got an A. She really cares about her students and is always available for questions.

Took his class for Women's Self Defense and loved it. It was a physical class and does require you to learn defensive moves and be able to demonstrate the skills you learn. His "tests" are based on the skills you learn and are easy if you know the skill. Participation does matter and will make or break your grade.
clear note

Graded by 5 assignments, 3 quizzes, 3 review guides, 3 exams, 6 labs + reports. Savita is so kind, always welcomes questions, and is very accessible outside of class. Exams mirror the review guides, and an outline is given for every exam. Very straightforward grading and always gives amazing feedback. Excel heavy lab reports. Take this prof!!!

Professor Pratt does not respond to anything over email. He is disorganized and ends class as quickly as possible so he can get out. If you need help with literally anything outside of class, good luck. You're on your own...

Amazing professor! She explains the subjects well, and even slows down if you don't understand a topic! 10 webassigns, 4 data assignments + 1 final. I know the work sounds like a lot, but TRUST ME they help you in the end!! She wants you to figure out answers on your own and THINK. Work is clearly stated. If you fail her class, its your own fault

The professor assigned large group projects that seemed difficult for everyone in the class. When asked questions about the project, the professor would ignore or provide no help relating to said project. The class time was nothing but lectures and quizzes, a very difficult way to learn. Lecture heavy, hard to learn from
He is a fantastic professor and person. Lectures are easily understood and he covered a ton of topics in one semester. He is patient and engaging.
He just loves yapping in class, he doesn't want to solve any numerical problems in the class but the exam will be filled with numerical. Wish you luck.

Dean Miller really knows his stuff, and he's good at keeping your attention when he teaches. He has a great sense of humor, too. The feedback he gives is great, and he makes you get out there for some real-world reporting, which is terrifying, but a great experience. He stressed me out, but I loved the class and I learned a lot. 10/10 class!

Dr. D is a respectable professor. They make you work very hard for your grade, but give you lots of help if you need it. They explain topics in depth in class and have great lectures. They expect lots of participation and you MUST READ THE BOOK to pass.
We had rhythm of 1 quiz every weekend and one weekend he assigned 2 quizzes and did not tell anybody so I got a zero on the second one.

I typically take RMP reviews lightly since most people will only speak on their bad experiences but TRUST ME WHEN I SAY SHE IS GENUINELY A TERRIBLE PROFESSOR. She refused to help students when they got stuck and I do not think she cares about the success and well-being of her students. Extremely hard professor for NO REASON. Avoid at all costs.

He is PhD student who needs to learn how to teach .... So confusing, reads only slides, no experience... 2 midterms and 1 final with giving preparation, but on exam you can find something new, that you never came across during semester...
Terence is a pretty good guy, very engaging and clearly enjoys his work. Course material itself was very interesting and I couldn't wait for the next class!

I love Professor Hunt! She is so sweet and nice! I wish I could take her again but it's my last semester. She is so hopeful and if you let her know you are struggling she is more than willing to offer extra credit to you. I highly recommend this professor!!

There are times where he is hard to understand, but he is good with most questions. Definitely ask questions if you don't understand something because the material connects. He also puts his decimal points at the top of his numbers, so watch for that when taking notes.
Excellent professor.. Cares about his students..

Chavez is clear on what he wants from his students. Chavez is practical but talks fast in his lectures. If you do not put in the work and effort, you will not do well. He's knowledgeable, cares and respects education, and gives you the tools you need to do well in this course.

This R course was difficult for me because I had never coded before but she was so supportive and gave me lots of support resources to learn so it was easier. R is very useful in the data analytics field and is a great tool to know so definitely recommend this class. If you struggle, reach out to her for help and she will gladly support you

Had him for AT 102 and AT 338. AT 102 is just a boring class. I think his classes are really easy as long as you attend lectures and take notes. Tests are mostly straight out of the lectures. In AT 338, there may be a question or two out of the book. He is very approachable and easy to reach. Usually have online quizzes and sometimes online exams.

Heilferty is a really sweet professor who tries to get to know her students even in such a big class. The course is made up of a few easy textbook quizzes and a final group project which you just have to finish to do well on. The lectures can be a little boring but overall a really easy class.

She's a nice professor. But I'm not going to pay over $500 dollars for a class to have other students "teach" me. She explains for 15 mins off a powerpoint and the rest of the class is group work. she does not go over the group work and only posts the answers on blackboard. plus gives a quiz every week. Calc is a hard subject.I had to drop it.

Though this class is online, Dr. Kaya seems to be a very sweet & thoughtful prof. You don't need to do too much to earn an A, but some discussion Q's are quite time-consuming & generally require some research. As a STEM student, this class showed me how SOCY can be a really interesting subject, & I regret not taking it in a classroom setting. 5/5
Professor Beland's class was fairly easy. Most of the class time was him presenting the power point and explaining the content of each slides. Simply being there and taking notes was enough to pass.
The actual Goat. TAKE HER

Dr. Fortune is literally the greatest man. One class he showed up with a Kenough cup and that pretty much sums him up. The class is semi-difficult but he will work tirelessly to explain content in every way he can think of. Show up to class ready to work hard and have fun. PLEASE TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

Took her for Arts & Humanities Gen Ed. We met only 1x weekly for a short time for discussion, but did all work asynchronously. There's a lot of reading, but as expected for this course. 4 essays in semester, plus small discussion responses and short quizzes. Speaks very clearly in recorded lectures! Understanding, caring, encourages discussion.
Good information learned from the class. Make sure you show up to class.
This guy is one of the best math teachers/professors I've ever had and one of the best professors at UNO. Take his class. His teaching style is enthusiastic and no bs. He deserves a raise and bonus!
Philip was my business law prof. He was funny, nice, and an overall good prof. His classes were interesting and easily understandable. I would recommend his class to others.

Best professor I've had at Waterloo. I normally don't participate in lectures but I felt very good participating in this class. Always keeps you entertained with the math taking place. Cannot stress how good he is. If you have the option of taking any class with him TAKE IT.

Good teach, very pleasant. You'll need your textbook and her notes to do well in this class. I noticed that what she talks about in class is important for the test. She makes you get in the textbook and she's a stickler for good writing, especially APA. I'd say Mrs. Pollard's is tough but fair.

Professor Fritz is highly qualified but has an inability to articulate ideas and lectures to the class. The tests are hardly based on readings and lectures. Most of the test's answers come from outside information which you don't know about. Documentaries did not tie into readings. She rambles on. AFTER she curved the class grade we all had a C-.

Best professor and class I took that semester. He's pretty chill when giving the lectures and explaining the class. If you don't understand, he will explain again. He assigned movies and makes you write at least a paper of anything that caught your attention in the movie just to test how your writing is. He gives a couple of HWs and tests/exams.

HNSC 2120, Introduction to Epidemiology (with Lab), Professor is really great we had no midterm, just BB, weekly quizzes and labs, participation counts, and a final. The quizzes are not hard at all all the answers are on the powerpoint she provides you with each week. The labs can be done as group work. She gives extra credit.

Awesome professor! He made the class enjoyable and assignments all had a point! Never felt like busywork, always learned something from it. Reasonable, helpful, and understanding with students. Fully recommended as a screenwriting professor.

I am horrible at math. But, I am about to finish this class with an A and that's all because Kim is an excellent teacher! She will go over every homework and quiz question that we need help with until we understand. She answers messages outside of class, too. Don't buy the textbook, because we didn't use it. Very friendly woman, too!

She doesn't offer any outline for exams and expects you to be fluent in speaking and accent by the final. Expects the impossible and will not budge for any concerns. Does not listen to her students AT ALL
even though the semester for spring 2024 isn't over, I couldn't wait to evaluate this professor. He is awful..wow! I know Hostos college needs professors..But try harder to bring in Good ones ...

AMAZING. Karen is an absolute angel. She makes the clinical experience even better. I felt completely comfortable being in her class because she really cares about the patients and the students. She allows you to learn from any mistakes you made instead of making you feel stupid. I would take her for every clinical. Do yourself a favor & take her.
No one likes College foundations, but despite that Mr. Thompson was a great instructor. Hilarious!

The first time I took her class I think 30% of the class failed. We read letters from the last class saying "DO NOT TAKE. AMOUNT OF WORK OF 3 CLASSES" and she laughed. The amount of work is too much if you have any other classes + work. She's kind of unfriendly too which sucks. Part of why I changed my major was so I wouldn't have to take her again
same as the other bad ones

I got bad grade in this class but mostly for not doing the Final Project on time or the checkpoints. The Final Project is easy, you just need to follow instructions well and put time into it. All it is is a Powerpoint comparing the cultures of two different countries. Do the study guides (no more than 15 questions) for the 3 Exams @testing center!

Take her she is truly one of the best professors at Collin. She truly loves what she teaches and will help with any questions. Just don't be lazy and put in the work. Truly take her she is super sweet.

I cannot stress this enough: the best professor I have ever had. Andrea is charming, knowledgable and kind. Whether it was in the classroom or online due to the pandemic, she demonstrated care for her students. She makes the material easy to understand and you can tell she's passionate. If given the chance, I will absolutely take her again!

Professor Vanesha Nicholson is a nice professor, and she wants students to be successful both in her class and outside the class. If students follow her instructions, they will be fine. She encourages students to build their networking connections.

Tough class but  that's the subject. Alot of hw and studying required but again, that's the class. Fair exams and quizzes. She is one of the best teachers in the math department, if she is offered for a class you need, take without second thoughts.

I took her during the spring semester and still believe she is one of the best professors at del mar. Throughout the course, we were assigned six papers and short assignments. The class can be a tad overwhelming, but she will walk you through everything. She will respond to dumb questions and push you to write your best!

Clear explanations, accessible outside of class, answers the emails within a reasonable delay, cares about her students. She makes hard concepts seem easy! Open to criticism. Keeps the board clear and explanations to the point, she gives examples after every definition/theorem to make us understand better. Overall, loved her class!Thank You Ms. Ky!

I'm confused by the other ratings because this class wasn't even that hard. You have about 2 assignments a week. One due on Wednesday and the other on Saturday. The assignments are not even that hard. Just follow the rubric and instructions and you'll be good. He does not grade harshly. He puts out videos each week to go over the assignments.

Professor Adames is amazing. I was seriously struggling with calculus and almost failed the class but he gave me extra work that boosted me to a B. Would definitely take him again. And he is a student himself which is good because he puts himself in the students's shoes and is very understanding
Take any class with her. Reasonable for a GE which made it easier to learn and put in effort

Awful slides. Awful lecturing. Always shows up late. Has some of the most vague lecture slides available when the prerequisite course for this had some of the most clear slides for similar material. Her disorganization makes your experience as a student in her class much worse.

Open your eyes RCBC this Professor is the reason so many students are not successful in this program. Quite frankly it feels like she could give less than a rats behind about her students. The worst part is you CANNOT avoid her as a professor. Get ready to teach yourself everything and pray to sweet baby Jesus you pass.
If you do what it is asked, you will do great in his class, easy A

He is new at City Tech. He was very caring and tried his best to help all students despite the extremely difficult class. He wants everyone to succeed and is very knowledgable and experienced about psychiatric nursing.

Donate was one of the worst professors I've had here at Davidson. She's very unhelpful throughout the entire course and not very easy to access outside of the classroom if you need help. Very unclear grading criteria and has really unhelpful feedback. Will put things on the test that you never learned in class then say it's our fault for not knowin
Pretty easy going professor. Show up, complete homework assignments and exams, and youll pass. Mancu even will allow take home exams sometimes as well.
Sweet professor, trying to push you going further. A lots of works but each one is really engaging for me. Definitely loving design for patterns although its my minor only.

I would take her class again if I have another chance. She is a very amazing professor! Do not miss the chance to get an A. You will not be disappointed if you choose her class. You will learn a lot from her. You will see a very clear lesson from her. And you can get an A EASILY. A very responsible and caring professor!!! The best ever!!!!
One of the best professors I have ever had, she motivated me to crack my coop interviews.

Dr. Chatterjee is one of my favorite professors at Brookline so far. He is very clear about the assignments and what is to be expected on the quizzes and exams. He is always willing to help students who don't understand, yet he is never degrading about it like some teachers can be. He's pretty funny too. 10/10 would recommend.
He's pretty good he's a little odd but he's not a bad teacher. I took the evening section so I was stuck with him but can't complain much.

Shaw is an amazing Professor. She will push you to keep improving and challenge you to step outside of your comfort zone. At first her class can be overwhelming, but if you like a good challenge, youll do great in her class.

Dr. Morris is the best professor I have had, she is very passionate about Spanish and she cares a lot for her students. Every class is engaging and eventful and the course is not too difficult. The tests are only on grammar, not other content which is nice. Overall, she is a great person and professor. I highly recommend taking one of her classes.

One of the best lab instructors I've had. He makes class fun but also covers the material my lecture professor does not teach. I look forward to walking into my honors lab because of this professor! Be prepared to do a lot of work outside of the lab though. I highly recommend this professor if you want to learn something and actually enjoy class!

Idk what these people mean that she's not respectful. She's very reasonable and respectful and I would go so far to say that she's caring. If you put in time and effort and show that you care about the class, she's an amazing, intelligent, professional professor and a kind person.

Just awful. He was very hard to understand, his TA graded things super harshly and he knew it but didnt do anything about it. The lab portion of this class was so difficult and made the whole course not manageable. He gave no instruction, gave no help, wasnt accessible and just wasnt understanding. Avoid at all costs. A good lab teacher is huge.

Klavens was really straightforward and understanding, just reach out. He tells you why you got your answer wrong and how to fix it and responds to emails quickly. His explanations definitely helped me with lecture since he went step by step through problems. Weekly extra credit, classwork, quizzes, and HWs are pretty easy with a few small projects
This guy is amazing! And one of the best professors in my opinion.

Impossible to understand him and doesn't engage the class in any way - you will learn nothing in this class and will be clueless all semester. You won't start getting grades until well after midterms, and the grading system is totally irrational. Would never take this class again.
Very easy A. Very easy going professor, all exams were online. Has lots of knowledge on his area of study, and expects good research and content in projects, but is very kind in grading.
Kate is super nice and very accessible outside of class. Tests were difficult but fair. I definitely recommend taking multivariable calc from her.
Best online lab I have taken at UTA. If you put in the work you will get a good grade.

I honestly wasn't the best student in this class; however, he was a great teacher and had great lecture that had slideshows posted online in case you missed class. He is very caring and charismatic which made going to class not feel like a drag. Taking a different class with him this semester, highly recommend.
I loved his class, I learned so much and absolutely miss this class. He is so understanding and really loved teaching.

Consistent schedule: Tues. Quizzes, Thurs. Discussion Q's. Lectures with PowerPoints & will tell you on Thurs. what will be on Tues. Quiz. 2 Exams - study all quizzes. Gives study guide for listening portion. Presentation and 2 essays. GREAT teacher!!!!!!! He is very understanding. Wish I could take more of his classes.

Easy class and the professor was awful, depending on how you look at it . He was constanlty on his phone and was rude incredibly rude if you try to disturb him. Sometimes out class would just stand there and wait for instruction while he was texting. If you dont care about that then you wont have problems, just show up and do the activity and leave

Attendance is not mandatory, but if you miss a lecture itll be difficult. Graded on three tests and drops lowest If all taken not including the final. Study guides and very similar to tests. Really good professor but class is hard trys best to help you understand. Textbook is used but he will give you the pdf online. Pdf file sold at bookstore

Absolutely loved her class. Even though it was a 7:25am class, and I have no real interest in Music history, she made is interesting. Add to the fact that she's went to Julliard. Just don't be late, don't miss too many classes, pay attention and you'll pass with an A. One final paper where you have to go to a recital or opera. Not to hard.

The best professor Ive ever taken at UTSA. Make sure to go to class and write down notes because she does not post them on BB. She takes attendance randomly but the topics you go over in class are interesting so it makes you not want to miss class. She makes it a thing to know the students name and I think thats great. Gives you a review for exam
He is very intelligent and helpful. He made the complicated topics easier through his teaching efficiency. Such a best and great professor.

The class structure is all over the place so be prepared to be confused. All the work is done on your own so you have to make sure you doing it. She does do pop quizzes and she is strict about work. You have to put a lot into your work to get a 100.
Super great professor, there is no way one can fail this class unless they are just not doing the coursework or keeping up with due dates. Open note tests and all. Extra credit every test too.

Great teacher, very knowledgeable and gives great lectures. Extremely helpful and always available if I had questions. Would definitely take again. Truly cares about each student and wants them to learn as much as possible, answers all questions and really wants her students to learn. I was bummed I couldn't take her for next English class.

One of the few caring professors at UCR. He's an extremely nice professor who really wants his students to pass. I suggest y'all pay a lot of attention on the stories read because all your essays depend on them.

This is my first time taking a class with her. I think she needs to make the class easier. She expects students to read too much material for a level 300 course. She teaches this course like a 500 level or higher.
He does make you keep your camera on, but it's a communications class. Duh! One of the best teachers I've ever come across. To quote his favorite, David, he's simply the best!

The professor is amazing! The course consists of various homework assignments, two projects, and quizzes spread throughout the semester which are all pretty easy in my opinion. The grading is fair and the class is interesting. Attendance is not mandatory.
Very intense homework schedule in terms of both reading and writing. She's knowledgeable but be prepared to work or you will not survive.

Professor Du genuinely cares about her students, she will provide everything you need to succeed. She can sometimes be quick to explain things, but she is tremendously helpful when you ask questions. She grades generously and will give opportunities to earn a point or two back on every exam.
He's such a great professor! Super nice guy! The content is also really interesting. Definitely worth taking!

Dr C cares that you learn the material. His lectures are fairly short and to the point. He is very clear on what he expects from the class and he will answer any question you have. He usually gives feedback on why he graded the way he did. He is an all-around good professor.

I really enjoyed this class. I was dreading it since it's a Gen ed but prof. Kadic quickly made it one of the most engaging classes I've been in so far. I feel like I learn something new every Tuesday and Thursday. I did struggle a bit with writing papers in the beginning, but all it took was having a conversation with her and that helped so much.

Amazing professor who gives interesting lectures and has you thinking about the topic at hand. She's very kind and provides good feedback and makes you want to learn more and doesn't feel like a writing intensive class.

There are weekly problem sets that can take a lot of time to complete, but Dr. Agazzi is good about having office hours and helping. He was also very generous with his grading. Before class, he puts all of his notes online, which can be helpful for following along in lecture, but his handwriting can be difficult to read.

Although this class is difficult at times, Myers really made the class interesting and achievable. The project that we work on throughout the semester has a lot of parts but he gives good feedback and will extend due dates if you need more time. He tells you to buy the book but its not necessary since we've learned the material in past classes.
Very good guy, tests can be tricky, but not too bad. Very nice guy though and very helpful.
tough grader, and unfair!

I loved Professor Griffith's Men's Health class! He's super fun and engaging and the content itself is really eye-opening especially with today's increased focus on just women's health. He does have pop quizzes, but as long as you read the assigned readings they are totally doable. If you pay attention and follow the rubrics, you'll get an A!!

such an amazing prof. i cant stress enough how lovely she is! she cares about her students and the class. She does not require many assignments & if the weather is bad out, she either cancels or doesn't take attendance! so understanding. she is truly an amazing person and prof! Show up, participate, hand in your few assignments and you'll pass!

One group presentation but you pick your partner and topic, two 1500 word papers, and occasional reading but chapters aren't long. TAKE HER CLASS! She teaches using skits from movies and comedy shows. I would take her ever semester if I could. Ended the class with a 126% Easy A

Awful teacher. Once u enter class you see a bunch of people leaving within the first 10 minutes due to how badly she teaches. She has a thick accent along with a monotone voice it's borderline impossible to listen. I tried looking at her homework solutions and couldn't even understand her writing. All and all, avoid this teacher at all costs.
He was such a great teacher and always makes sure to post his power-points online. He also emails in advance if he misses. Very lenient and nice, will pass if you do homework.
She was the best English Professor I have taken so far. I hate English, but she made the class easy and more enjoyable.

The only assignments the whole class were the four tests, but he tells you exactly what you need to know for the test. Only reason I didn't say it was easy is because finance is a hard class. Definitely have to study but he tells you what to pay attention to. He also provided very practical and real-life examples that were helpful and useful.

I wouldnt take this class again because... well I only did it for credit, but shes a great professor! I like her a lot, and the class work is not hard. During the end you have to do a critique on plays and watch other plays, but trust me, its not that bad. She actually makes learning fun too.

Professor Baggett is amazing. Her lab materials are so detailed and incredibly informative. She gives awesome feedback to your labs and does her best to deliver the material in a way you can understand. The University of Alabama is lucky to have her.

The most disorganized professor I've ever had. Cancels class all the time because of his schedule conflicts and lectures get so off-topic. He is also really bad at returning grades and feedback even though you're only graded by a few assignments. He's a nice guy and knows his stuff but class can feel boring and he has high expectations for papers.

50% of your grade is determined by your weekly group discussions, where it's easy to get an A. Although there is a lot of weekly readings (40 pages +) that you have to annotate, it is a very easy and interesting class to take.  The final was almost like a personal reflective response. Would take again for sure!!

Do NOT take this class. It is easy in the beginning, but it gets harder down the road. You will be tested on things that were not talked about or in the study guide due to him using a generic one from an associate. He says things, and then takes them back so do not trust his word.

For CHS 211, Dr. Murray was a great instructor who made class enjoyable to attend. The only things to be weary about when taking this class is to stay super consistent with the work load because Murray will not give late work any second thought no matter what, so always try to stay way ahead of deadlines to avoid any issues with online submissions

I attended this class last year and then again this year with a different instructor. After 4 weeks I switched to the lectures of Dr C. Kuss. This is a hard class, but Dr Kuss explains so well. He is very smart and helpful. I give him full marks, because I passed this class because of him. Lots of assignments, quizzes, etc, but marking is clear.

Alex did a good job at perfecting my essays to a more college level. She did have us buy a textbook and ran a couple of lectures that seemed to go off our units' topic at times, but she was great with preparing us for our four different genres of writing. She's encouraging, kind to her students, and shows a clear passion for English.

Dr. Reschke is great. I postponed this class until my last semester because all the reviews about "so much reading" scared me off. The reading is literally not bad at all & his entire class is very straightforward. He does not try to trick you. If you just do the reading, you will be set for class, quizzes, and exams. He's a very kind professor.
Great class, tough field projects. Came away learning a ton.

Awful its a 200 level art class and yet she expects you to memorize and know all the terminology and is a picky grader for exams. Attendance is super important and if you miss a couple of days she will drop your grade significantly. Paper heavy just don't take

terrible.

Awesome! Luke helped me out with my Eureka project! Great man also a great professor!

She told me a family death was no excuse to miss her exam when I asked to take a make-up at a later date. I was absolutely shocked to receive that response to my polite email during such a dark time in my life. Would not recommend taking her class if you want to be respected as a student.

I had him for my summer bridge class recently, I wasnt very fond of the fast pace we were learning at but he understood that all of our content was being compressed into a 6 week time period so he gave a lot of extra credit opportunities. Professor Fogarty's passion for teaching and personal care for every student was on display each day. He explains the law in a digestible way to fully grasp the legal concepts. This class and teacher is not for the faint of heart! His teaching style is intense. If you lack common sense you will not pass. The funnest part of the class were the group projects. READ STUDY READ!

Professor A, as we students know him is very accomplished and knowledgeable about the subject he teaches - International Human Resources. She does very lecture heavy powerpoint presentations, and I personally have a hard time learning this way. Her assignments can be confusing but just ask her questions! She does a really good job at explaining them in class! It is very discussion and personal experience based which helps with remembering material!
Dr. E was great, some weekly pop quizzes, but they are basically the homework problems. Tests are open note/excel and not far from the quizzes.

Buckley is the man. I can tell you that he cares about his students very much, and he cares about teaching such a dense class. The quizzes are hard but his study guides are literally the quizzes so study those. Welcomes any questions and concerns. 1 big research paper, 2 quizzes, 2 exams including the final. 10/10 would take again.

I love art history but I found the class boring and there was way too much content. The professor isn't engaging, I could never hear what he was saying and what I was hoping to be a really interesting class turned out to be more history than art and I didn't like it. I also hate learning from a textbook.

Professor G gives you real tools that you need in life to succeed. It's really, really easy to pass the class. Just do the work for the four speeches you have and you're golden. He's very, very caring so if you have any issues with public speaking, talk to him. All in all, easy A and you walk away with life lessons that'll help you outside of class
Very dedicated to students!

I had McCullough for Calc 1 and he was a great professor. His lectures followed a clear schedule and structure which I found was a main reason for me doing so well in that class. Probably one of the worst 8 week periods of my life in terms of things outside of my control. On top of that, the criteria used to grade the midterm was covered in INTL401, which I had not take yet. So I bombed the mid-term with an F. This professor gave me every chance to learn the material, let me resubmit, with 4 hours to spare, to save my 4.0

Matthew is an incredible professor, I am not a science person, I am an art student who took this class for my physical science requirement, but he made the material interesting and was clearly very passionate about the subject.

Professor Wang has good lectures, and the notes are well done with pictures and examples, and all of them are posted online. The homework is challenging but reasonable, it took about 1-2 hours a week. He's always reachable by email (sometimes even past midnight) and is willing to help. He's also just a very funny and upbeat guy in general.

I came to give him a one-star review only because his words did not align with his actions. At the beginning of the semester, he said he would allow late work as long as we turned it in & attendance wasn't required; however, later in the semester, he changed his mind about late submissions & attendance. He lowered student's grades for not showing
This class is a breeze if you just do the work! The readings and two papers are the only assignments! Go to his office hours to proof read ur essays and youll get a A!
David was absolutely phenomenal! Easily accessible by email and willing to setup zoom calls outside his office hours. Come to class ready to discuss and you'll learn a ton with him.

Definitely an amazing Professor. He explains things so well. There were some extremely difficult readings, but his lecture just made everything so make sense. Also you can literarily ask him any question about philosophy and he would give you an "aha" moment. The workload was also reasonable

Dr. Jane was a wonderful professor. The work was pretty easy. She pretty much gave us the answers to most homework questions and work during the class. Dr. Young is a class act. He not only engages with students over the class work but also in their lives outside of school. He really wants you to do well and gives you the means to do it. He is able to read the class very well and change the pace of the class based on their understanding. I was never overwhelmed in this class and learned a lot!

Taken online, the class is solely just uploaded powerpoint presentations with optional audio recordings. It's an interesting class, and prof. Hartman really seems to be considerate of students' time and acknowledges that online classes are hard and a lot of work. 10/10 would take any class with this prof, I really enjoy her and her teaching style!!
Outlined expectations clearly in class. This is a 4 credit course, so hard work was needed to do well.

Amazing prof!!! Very approachable, willing to give extensions. Will even let you redo an assignment if you feel you could do better. A very fair marker. Overall I have learnt so much. Would definitely take her class. In fact I registered for her English lit class as well !

Amazing teacher, she is very invested in what she's doing and is a great and caring teacher. You really feel like you know more about the art of writing and more about life when you leave. She is very accessible, gives you the option to do effort-based grading (Not as easy as it sounds but interesting), and is laid back but is still professional.

Prof. Burroughs is  very responsive to emails and genuinely cares about his students.  Allows for extra credit on major exams (except final).  I took an 8-week online course format and there were: 10+ quizzes, several discussion posts, four major exams, one short paper,  and a final.  Very interesting and informative class!

BEST ORGO TA EVER! I have her for Orgo 1 lab and she makes sure everyone in the lab is on the same page and never throws us in the deep end. I never feel clueless or unsure of what to do. Shes so honest and caring I love her ! Gives lots of feedback on rough drafts, so you can ace the final drafts. Very understanding that not every student is the same and many come from different backgrounds of educations and schools. So glad taking her again in spring for English comp 102!
He is a knowledgable instructor. Give plenty of applications of Machine learning in his lectures and provide good explanations. Also, fast in replying to emails.

This was a remote class. Lectures covered content straight from chapters. She made time to assist those who were struggling more than others. Ms. Donkerbrook encourages people to participate. Very prompt responder; whenever I emailed her she replied either on the same day or tomorrow.

Too much reading was assigned for the class. We were asked to read around six to eight long articles each week. All the slides for the objects and places looked similar. I had lots of respect for the professor but I was blindsided by so much disrespect from him for no reason. He made me lose interest in the subject for ever.

Dr. Boyle's a great professor and clearly has a passion for statistics. There's a free online textbook but I don't know of anyone who actually used it. The class is lecture heavy but she gives you printable notes to follow along with. If you have taken statistics before or are very good at it, the class may seem slow but if not it'll be paced well

Not a bad prof if you wanna learn the basics. But be prepared to do lots of practice questions on your own which I should have done. dr. ward is incredibly knowledgeable in her field and runs each class with the intention of making sure you get all the information. after taking this class i feel more and more that i should have been a public health major. if you show up, participate, and put in effort to do your best work, you'll do fine in the class. definitely would recommend!

She is very easy going professor. just try to attend all the classes and try to ask as many questions as you can, since here lecture notes are not perfect, but asking questions, she will add detail to her notes and so you will just need to study them to pass the course. The class was great. We had fun and learned a lot. Easily approachable and very willing to help all of his students succeed.

I had a fun time taking this class! she's funny and makes the lecture relatable. Show up to class and take notes and you'll get an A. She does use LearnSmart for modules but I just did my 10 required modules in the trial period. She's awesome!

The absolute best teacher I have ever had in my entire life. She makes such hard classes so clear, I wish she could teach every level of math to me for the rest of school. If you're scared of math 331, don't be, she is a sweet heart and is so easy to understand. the GOAT
Professor Gonzalez is very encouraging and inspirational. He takes the time out to give light jokes and ties his lectures in real time and issues. His honest feedback is greatly appreciated

She often gives very little time to work on your projects, so be prepared for all-nighters. She is very picky about how everything is done and will be pretty harsh when critiquing your work. He was great during physical classes. I was doing amazing in his class, and i got good grades. But I told him I was stressed because i lost family members to covid. McMahan is a very understanding and caring professor. Stoutamyer is not a very good professor. He looks like he doesn't know what he's doing, reads off powerpoints but can't explain stuff otherwise. Class is boring and we don't do much. Theres a lot of essays but I feel like he's not hard on grading. There's peer reviews for every assignment.

This professor is very caring & sweet. Her lectures are very informative & on canvas if you miss class. Interesting & inspiring if you wish to become a teacher!

Kimberly is a very nice professor. However, she grades very tough. I wrote papers which I think were of widely varying quality but got the same grade on all three. Its like she comes up with a score and decides how to get there while grading.

Sheel is genuinely one of the best math professors in USC. He gives clear lectures and suitable amount of homework to help us understand the course material. He is always ready for you to ask for clarification of definitions/theorems/questions. I have an amazing geometry course here from him.

She's friendly but her presentations are definitely not the greatest. She basically reads off of them. I fell asleep multiple time during her lectures. Slim to none practice work in class. I just graduated and I have to say she is by far the worst professor ever. So much work, and when the Corona started she stopped teaching. This professor has a PhD that's good for nothing. She doesn't know what she's doing and requires you to write a lot. You have to answer discussion posts as an essay and have to take quizzes.

He is amazing! The best prof ever. Literally. I have never had a prof this amazing before. He cares a lot about the students and their progress. He replies to all your emails! Fun class. Learned a lot, but you have to keep up or you will get lost. The class builds on knowledge. If you go to lecture (don't skip!) and review sessions, the class is not difficult. Old exams posted are great study guides.

Incredibly tedious GE. Homework every week: journals with questions based on content covered. Professor Chorlian was amazing. If you put the effort into the weekly writing assignments, you'll get perfect scores. I really loved being in her class. Although it was her first time teaching the class, she did a really good job. She was always available for extra help and if you talked to her she was always willing to extend the deadline. Her exams can be a bit hard but if you really study, you can pass.
this class is mostly make up of tests with true or false questions. Terrible.

Worst class ever taken and the professor is ridiculous. Does not teach you what is on the exams. Exams are super difficult.

great prof

Great prof. who knows so much about film. He would assign a movie to watch every week. Based on the movie, there were 250-word papers and a 1 min flipgid- not too difficult. He doesn't believe in posting his notes before class for you to look at during the lecture and when you go to review them after class they are mostly nothing more than a series of pictures that if you didn't catch what he said during class you never get. David is such a good animation teacher. He is very strict and straightforward, and quite frankly, a bit intimidating. But he always has your back and gives really good feedback on your animations. Very good so far started stats was scared of this course but glad to have a good teach for it.

She has one of the most innovative teaching styles out there. She breaks down the material into 5-20 minute sections so it is easier to focus on the concept being taught. The assignments and practice questions had thorough solutions which really help one learn the content.

as someone shy, her class helped me socialize with others bc of the group discussions. readings weren't heavy at all they were quite doable, i had her for family dramas, shes very supportive and reading plays was interesting for a change from novels if you want that. had a few assignments to write plays so that's a pro if u like creative writing!

The Spanish department is hard because of the homework and tests, but professor Ore'Giron is so caring and understanding about it. She makes the class enjoyable and as easy as possible. She goes over specific items on the tests and quizzes and she is an easy grader. I got an A because of her help and I'm terrible at Spanish.
This professor is very knowledgeable and always there to help. If you need help, reach out to him, you will find him very helpful.

He encourages the class to participate during the lectures and his sessions are normally interactive. The professor was quite easy on grading even though his tests were hard. Learnt a lot from his homework and assignments.
This is the first time I have got an A+ class in sfu. I am very excited and very happy. I have to say that pengyu Liu's contribution is very huge, he is really a good teacher!

prof williams was great and she really cared about developing the students' writing. the class could be a lot of work at times, but the material was super interesting so it never felt overwhelming! writ107m has been my favorite class at ucsb so far. definitely recommend if you're interested in magazine writing or just creative writing in general!

Honestly I was scared to take her initially but she surprised me. She definitely knows her subject. I don't really like doing a lot of work & am a huge procrastinator so me getting an A is saying something. Gives extra credit for taking notes, I would use that instead of the study guide tbh bc its her words/hints. Just do the work & you got an A/B

Amazing professor. Psychology of language is cross-listed as both a psych and lsci class, so previous linguistic knowledge will be VERY helpful. Content heavy lectures, but manageable. Dr. Davis is a very good professor. This class does have a decent workload, but she gives you clear directions of what she expects. Dr. Davis grades all assignments very quickly and gives feedback. He does make his classes difficult on purpose then always explains how many people drop his classes.

I urge everyone who can possibly take this class to take it. Very few tests (open notes). One essay. Super relaxed with attendance. No homework. If you don't take this class you're missing out. Awesome professor! Guidelines were clear, and she didn't micromanage. Kept things simple and straightforward. If you follow the instructions and rubrics you're good to go. No guesswork required, like with other professors who won't communicate what they ACTUALLY want until "gotcha!" moments via comments on a poor grade.

This class was durable because of Professor Pedro. He explains so nicely and even explain old calc stuff. He reminds of of organic chemistry tutor in YouTube( Legend). He give clear instructions and u explains every questions u have During class.

Professor Gesualdi is a great teacher. Assigns a lot and I mean A LOTTT of reading, so be prepared for that. It is somewhat difficult to please her. The course itself is a little busy! Despite that, it was a great experience seeing as Professor Leatham helps students learn about the different ways of writing and the significance of it. So much for a job in admin.

Easy going professor in Ramapo College, I don't understand why people might not like her. No tests/quizzes, weekly readings/2-page discussion boards as homework, a few group projects. Lectures were a little boring at times but super helpful and easy to learn. Homework due once a week, didn't take more than an hour. Super nice & super helpful, tests were very easy if you studied (or wrote enough on your cheat sheet he allowed)
gave low grades for participation and assignments I genuinely don't know how I could have gotten full credit. please take another prof

Very engaging and always has interesting stories from the hospitality industry to tell. Guest speakers are interesting. He is a great professor, clearly cares about his students. I had a 7 am so it was a little rough. The assingmets were few and many of them linked together. I will say that once a unit he does a kahoot of the sources (Including textbook which he doesnt go over), this kahoot is worth that days participation. Overall, I found him really helpful.

Dr. Shelton is very passionate about astronomy and puts a lot of effort into the assignments.  The course engages you much more than PCS181 or PCS182 and if you don't love astronomy it will be a struggle.  I found him inspirational and found his assignments very enjoyable.  It may have been a bit Math heavy for a liberal course for some students.

She is so sweet and class is fun! She's very kind to her students and treats them as equals. Participation is important but honestly, after a couple of classes you'll open up. She gave us chances to have extra credits. She is kind and explains multiple ways to solve problems.

She is the best professor hands down in the CSE department. All her lectures are easy to understand and she guides you in case you get stuck. HWs are super organized and clear. Cheers!

Dr. Schroer's Ancient Cities class is a genuine pleasure to attend -- The man exudes passion and his deep attention to the students and to his course are constantly made obvious through the semester.

He gets hate for no reason. He gives an unbelievable amount of extra credit (like 50 bonus points for every 100 point test). His lectures are fine, he goes real slow so everyone understands. Great Professor. She makes class fun and shes very knowledgeable.

Dani is an excellent instructor who explains concepts clearly and is always willing to answer questions. He understands his students and is pretty funny, making organic chemistry more enjoyable. If you have the opportunity to take his class, I highly recommend it!
She is a very sweet professor. She was more of a friend to our class than a teacher. Very encouraging, fun, and I would definitely recommend her.

Professor Smith Jones is about as caring a professor as I've ever had. I fell behind due to illness half way through the semester and didn't think I would pass. Professor Miller is wonderfully organized which makes it easier to take in difficult concepts. Legendary guy. Go to his review sessions before the exams. Teaches you more in the review than you will learn in all of the lectures. Goes into great detail on the topics, answers questions, and is a funny and caring guy!
I took her for General chem 1. Her lectures are very clear and she's understanding. Im taking her for General chem 2 as well.
Dr. White was amazing, and had a really interesting class. Sometimes lots of work due to being a 7-week course, but very manageable. Great class, and even better professor!

Professor is chill and each class consists of walking around campus or parks (Beware hill and stadium days!!). One easy, multiple choice midterm and final. Very good lecturer. He's funny and makes lectures interesting, but attending class isn't necessarily required. Lowest 2 quiz grades get dropped (8 total quizzes). Ciszek is an absolute light. Her personality made lectures very engaging and she was always prepared. Zero recorded lectures, so you basically have to teach yourself EVERYTHING. Unless you want to email the professor 15 times a week for every single question you have. Really easy going prof. Everything you need to know is posted online. Final exam is open book so print off whatever you need. He also posts study guides for tests. Good prof.
